arguments.summary: A critical credential compromise incident was detected originating from external IP 185.220.101.42, which conducted a network scan on an internal IT asset (WS-IT-101 at 10.0.2.15). Despite detection and analysis confirming the breach, attempted bulk credential revocation via IAM/PAM was denied due to policy or validation constraints. No malware was found on the initial scan target, but lateral movement and privilege escalation are confirmed.

Successful authentication from 10.0.2.15 to domain controller (10.0.1.1) using CORP\helpdesk account.
Anomalous access patterns detected in Finance OU; investigation initiated.
Analysis confirms pass-the-hash attack across all 23 Finance OU accounts.
Attempt to revoke credentials for compromised accounts via IAM/PAM system failed due to policy restrictions.

arguments.summary: Critical credential compromise incident affecting the Finance OU. IOC analysis confirms malicious scanning from external IP 185.220.101.42, followed by lateral movement and pass-the-hash exploitation. All 23 accounts in Finance OU are confirmed compromised. Immediate bulk credential revocation and network isolation required. Multiple enforcement actions (IAM, firewall) were denied during Admin phase, indicating process or authorization failure.

timeline.description: External IP 185.220.101.42 initiated Nmap SYN scan against internal asset WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15). Detected and logged by IDS.
Successful authentication from compromised host WS-IT-101 as CORP\helpdesk. Lateral movement initiated.
UEBA detects low-risk anomalies for unknown user on 10.0.10.51; insufficient to trigger alert. EDR shows established outbound connection from chrome.exe.
SIEM correlation identifies 23 authentication events linked to Finance OU users. Pass-the-hash attack confirmed.
SOC attempts bulk credential revocation via IAM/PAM and firewall isolation. All actions denied due to lack of approval.
